items.title: Western Michigan University
items.summary: Western Michigan University is a public university in Kalamazoo, Michigan. The university has about 25,045 students. It was founded in 1903. Since 2017, the president of the university has been Edward B. Montgomery.

items.title: Khat
items.summary: Khat is a flowering plant native to tropical East Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. It is also known as qat, qaat, quat, gat, jaad, chat, chad, chaad, miraa and jimaa. The plant is grown commercially in Kenya, Ethiopia, Oman, and Yemen.
